column1: # One row for every file of tests/fuzz/corpus_connect_token (a file without a
# row, or a row without a file, fails the gate). Columns:
#   corpus file <TAB> mapped fields <TAB> netcode reference decision <TAB> rocketnet decision
# The netcode column is the netcode 1.02 decision recorded from the live run
# against tag v1.2.1 (tools/differential/README.md, the fuzz corpus mode);
# "-" where the case is not comparable (every raw file, and a structured file
# touching a field netcode 1.02 does not carry), which the gate never puts to
# netcode. The rocketnet column is the decision rocketnet must reach, and the
# gate holds the live decision to it on every row, comparable or not.
